surface_ball_test.name: Surface test / white gravity points
surface_ball_test.description: Equal white physics spheres released from rest. Flat surfaces hold them; slopes roll them; pockets collect them; open edges let them fall. Reusable jump-triggered component for walkable surfaces.
surface_ball_test.qfep_connection: A surface is tested by the trajectories it permits. The same initial conditions expose geometry, discretization and collision as observable constraints.

parameters.auto_trigger: Release on leaving this walkable surface
